user.title: Legacy Entity Naming
user.description:
Keeps entity names exactly as you typed them.

Installed on 2026.10 or earlier, it stops the 2026.11 update from rewriting your stored names. On 2026.11 and later, the switch turns off adding device and area names in front of your names. Names are snapshotted at every start so they can be restored.

unsupported_version.title: Legacy naming display patch is off
unsupported_version.description: Home Assistant {ha_version} is not supported by this version of Legacy Entity Naming ({reason}). Your stored names are not changed, but dashboards and friendly names now follow Home Assistant's own naming rules until Legacy Entity Naming is updated. Snapshots and the restore action keep working.

untested_update.title: Wait before updating to Home Assistant {latest}
untested_update.description: Legacy Entity Naming has only been tested with Home Assistant {tested}. Home Assistant {latest} might change entity names in a way it can't prevent. Wait for a Legacy Entity Naming update, or take a backup first. If names do change, they can be restored from the name snapshots.

shield_failed.title: Upgrade shield could not be armed
shield_failed.description: Legacy Entity Naming could not prepare the entity registry on Home Assistant {ha_version}. Do not update to 2026.11 until this is fixed, or the update will rewrite your stored entity names. Check the logs for details.
